capabilities: Fold or unfold properties of a single note from the file explorer context menu
Apply fold state to every note in a folder, including subfolders
Fold or unfold properties across the whole vault via commands
Persist the fold state for notes that have not been opened yet
extras: Works on desktop and mobile and requires Obsidian 0.16.3 or later; installation is documented both via Community Plugins and manually.
intentEvidence: Obsidian lets you fold properties one note at a time. Fold Properties does it in bulk
motivation: Long property blocks push the actual writing down the page, and native folding only works per note.
problem: Obsidian only lets you fold properties one note at a time, so long property blocks push writing down the page across many notes.

relations.evidence: Sync Folds keeps your fold states, folded properties included, in sync across devices
Quick Select lets you run commands like Fold properties in all notes with Mod + number

summary: Bulk tool that folds or unfolds the properties block of one note, a whole folder, or the entire vault.
